company.name: IQRA'A Audiobooks
company.shortDescription: educational content creation startup that aims to change the way educational content and classes is shown or offered to different entities
company.description:
An entrepreneurial-driven startup company envisioning a future where you can easily read and study through one of the most convenient platforms. Schools will be able to use our platform or incorporate out data into theirs. Students can read, listen to, highlight their books, and talk to their teachers via live chat! 
Moreover, it is a vision that focuses on reinforcing the beauty of the Arabic language in the youth’s minds.
